evidence.summary: Held-out evaluation shows that Port C behaves as a distinct difficult-to-model region. Ridge achieved 96.875% decision accuracy (31/32) and Kernel Ridge achieved 93.75% (30/32), but both models had their largest score errors on the Port C point: 0.8544 for Ridge and 0.7677 for Kernel Ridge. Removing the Port C point substantially improved Ridge from R2=0.5316 and MAE=0.0566 to R2=0.952 and MAE=0.031, while Kernel Ridge improved from R2=0.6008 and MAE=0.051 to R2=0.931 and MAE=0.028. This indicates that Port C represents a distinct or unstable region relative to the dominant scoring relationship.
